name: fight15-s23
title: A newcomer's defaults at 640x360: Host a Game, Create Lobby, Join, Ready, Start and play

scripts.host.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToOptions
wait_ms 600
select_settings_page Network
wait_ms 450
select_settings_page Network:Basics
wait 3
video_mark network-defaults-host
assert_label LabelNetworkConnectionValue Automatic
assert_label ComboMatchStatusWidget When needed
assert_text_fits LabelNetworkConnectionValue
activate ButtonNetworkAdvanced
wait 4
select_settings_page Network:Files
wait 4
video_mark files-default-host
assert_label LabelNetAutosaveHost Your hosting default
assert_label LabelNetAutosave On
assert_label LabelNetAutosaveInterval Every 5 minutes
assert_text_fits LabelNetAutosaveHost
select_settings_page Network:Basics
wait 3
activate ButtonNetworkConnectionChange
wait 4
assert_label ComboNetworkConnection Automatic
combo_select ComboNetworkConnection Relay only
wait_ms 600
assert_label ComboNetworkConnection Relay only
assert_text_fits LabelNetworkConnectionHint
post_command ButtonBackToMainMenu
wait_ms 900
assert_screen MainScreen
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Captain
activate ButtonMultiplayerHostGame
wait_ms 500
assert_substate HostSetup
video_mark host-setup-defaults
assert_text_fits ButtonMultiplayerCreate
setup_host_port {PORT}
activate ButtonMultiplayerCreate
wait_substate Lobby 90
write_lobby {PROBE_DIR}/lobby.json 90
video_mark fight15-host-listening
wait_connected 2 90
wait_ms 1200
wait_remote_ready 90
activate ButtonMultiplayerStart
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit
scripts.joiner.menu:
wait_ms 1800
activate ButtonMainToOptions
wait_ms 600
select_settings_page Network
wait_ms 450
select_settings_page Network:Basics
wait 3
video_mark network-defaults-joiner
assert_label LabelNetworkConnectionValue Automatic
assert_label ComboMatchStatusWidget When needed
assert_text_fits LabelNetworkConnectionValue
activate ButtonNetworkAdvanced
wait 4
select_settings_page Network:Files
wait 4
video_mark files-default-joiner
assert_label LabelNetAutosaveHost Your hosting default
assert_label LabelNetAutosave On
assert_label LabelNetAutosaveInterval Every 5 minutes
assert_text_fits LabelNetAutosaveHost
select_settings_page Network:Basics
wait 3
activate ButtonNetworkConnectionChange
wait 4
assert_label ComboNetworkConnection Automatic
combo_select ComboNetworkConnection Relay only
wait_ms 600
assert_label ComboNetworkConnection Relay only
assert_text_fits LabelNetworkConnectionHint
post_command ButtonBackToMainMenu
wait_ms 900
assert_screen MainScreen
activate ButtonMainToMultiplayer
wait_ms 600
assert_substate Landing
settext TextMultiplayerName Joiner
activate ButtonMultiplayerJoinGame
wait_ms 600
assert_substate JoinSetup
wait_file {PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
wait_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json 90
click_row PublicGameRowLobby:{PROBE_DIR_host}/lobby.json
assert_label LabelJoinSelected internet
assert_enabled ButtonMultiplayerConnect 1
activate ButtonMultiplayerConnect
wait_connected 2 90
wait_substate Lobby 90
wait_ms 1200
activate ButtonMultiplayerReady
wait_file {PROBE_DIR}/done.json 360
wait_ms 1400
exit
